spec.description: The alerts in effect for one marine region. The same as `alerts.get_active_alerts` narrowed by `region`, with the region in the path. Takes no other filter, so drills and test messages come back too; `alerts.get_active_alerts` with `status: ["actual"]` leaves them out.

region.description: Marine region: `AL` Alaska, `AT` Atlantic, `GL` Great Lakes, `GM` Gulf of Mexico, `PA` Pacific, `PI` Pacific Islands.

response.description: The alerts in effect for the region, as a GeoJSON feature collection. Empty when there are none.
